title: Blanchard: "Boy, did we screw up"
summary: John Brandenburg tells of Blanchard: "Boy, did we screw up", about 1947 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Roswell Army Air Field, New Mexico

tellings.quote: And all Blanchard would do was laugh and said, "Boy, did we screw up?"

plain: A researcher, John Brandenburg, told podcast host Jesse Michels what he says Roswell veterans passed on about Colonel Blanchard, an officer at the army airfield in Roswell, New Mexico, where something was said to have crashed in 1947. According to Brandenburg, when Blanchard was asked about the event later, all he would do was laugh and say, "Boy, did we screw up." Brandenburg tells it because it would mean the officer in charge admitted the official handling of the crash went wrong.
